views.container.title: Cloudflare Tunnel
views.tunnels.name: Tunnels
welcome.notInstalled:
cloudflared is not installed yet.
This extension will guide you through the whole setup, step by step.
[Get started](command:cloudflared.setup)
[Open the walkthrough](command:workbench.action.openWalkthrough?%22nachoaguirre.vscode-cloudflared%23cloudflared.gettingStarted%22)
welcome.installed:
cloudflared is ready. Expose a local port with a temporary public URL, no account needed.
[Expose a local port](command:cloudflared.exposePort)
Sign in to Cloudflare to create named tunnels on your own domain.
[Sign in to Cloudflare](command:cloudflared.login)
config.binaryPath: Absolute path to the `cloudflared` binary. Leave empty to auto-detect (PATH, common install locations, or the copy downloaded by this extension).
config.copyUrlOnStart: Copy the public URL to the clipboard as soon as a tunnel is up.
config.openBrowserOnStart: Open the public URL in the browser as soon as a tunnel is up.
config.extraArgs: Extra arguments appended to every `cloudflared tunnel` process, e.g. `["--protocol", "http2"]`.
config.showStatusBar: Show the Cloudflared item in the status bar.
config.stopTunnelsOnExit: Stop tunnels started by this extension when the window closes.
walkthrough.title: Get started with Cloudflare Tunnel
walkthrough.description: Expose your local services to the internet in minutes, from zero to a tunnel on your own domain.
walkthrough.install.title: Install cloudflared
walkthrough.install.description:
cloudflared is the small binary that creates the tunnel. The extension can download it for you.
[Install cloudflared](command:cloudflared.install)
walkthrough.expose.title: Expose a local port
walkthrough.expose.description:
Get a temporary public HTTPS URL for any local port. No account required.
[Expose a port](command:cloudflared.exposePort)
walkthrough.login.title: Sign in to Cloudflare (optional)
walkthrough.login.description:
Needed only for named tunnels on your own domain. Opens the Cloudflare dashboard in your browser.
[Sign in](command:cloudflared.login)
walkthrough.named.title: Create a tunnel on your domain
walkthrough.named.description:
Create a named tunnel, route a hostname to it and start it. The wizard does the three steps for you.
[Create named tunnel](command:cloudflared.createTunnel)
